title: helm(private): enhance values schema, init hooks, and upgrade/rollback compatibility for private-installer
author: Sofia Delgado
description:
Motivation: customers running Redwood Private in air-gapped and VPC environments hit edge cases during upgrades where Helm initJobs and values schema drift caused failed upgrades or orphaned CRs. This PR refactors the Helm chart for the private-installer to make values schema validation explicit, harden init hooks for idempotent bootstrapping, and add compatibility helpers for upgrade/rollback paths.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces a formal values schema (values.schema.json) covering previously implicit fields: storage.backend, initJobs.enabled, network.egress, and upgrade.rollbackPolicy. The schema is validated during helm template/lint CI and in the installer dry-run step.
- Adds templated predicates and defaulting for deprecated keys so older customer values files do not fail upgrades. Deprecated keys are mapped to canonical keys with a clear deprecation warning emitted via Helm notes.
- Reworks init hook jobs: make them idempotent by adding existence checks, exponential backoff, and a reconciliation-ready finalizer. Init jobs now emit a well-known ConfigMap when they complete successfully; the helm hooks watch this ConfigMap to coordinate subsequent resources.
- Adds an upgrade/rollback compatibility layer: a lightweight K8s Job (chart job) that runs pre-upgrade checks (schema validation, CR presence, KV cache migration marker) and post-upgrade health checks. For rollback we add a safe-fallback path that removes incompatible mutating webhook configs and re-applies previous CRD versions when possible.
- Improves templating for conditional resources (egress/peering and optional CSI drivers) to reduce accidental diffs during dry-run and to prevent unnecessary object recreation.
- Updates docs and examples under charts/private-installer/examples to include sample values for air-gapped installs and recommended upgrade sequence.

Files touched (summary): values.schema.json, charts/private-installer/templates/init-job.yaml, charts/private-installer/templates/upgrade-job.yaml, charts/private-installer/NOTES.txt, charts/private-installer/_helpers.tpl, charts/private-installer/values.yaml (defaults and deprecation mappings), ci/helm-lint.yml (schema validation step), docs/installer/upgrades.md, examples/airgap-values.yaml.

Testing performed:
- Unit: helm template/lint with schema validation in CI (added job).
- Integration: ran private-installer in KIND with simulated air-gap network rules and validated idempotent init job behavior across repeated installs/upgrades.
- E2E: staged upgrade from 1.2.3 -> 1.3.0 and rollback test; verified CRD compatibility helpers prevented data loss and that rollback preserved the previous controller ReplicaSet when possible.

Why this is safe: schema is additive and includes explicit deprecation mappings; init job changes are gated behind values.initJobs.enabled and do not run by default for existing installs unless customers opt-in to the new behavior. Pre-upgrade checks will block unsafe upgrades and provide clear remediation steps.

Migration notes and manual steps for some clusters are included in docs/installer/upgrades.md; ops teams should run the pre-upgrade job in dry-run to collect potential blockers before performing a live upgrade.

review_comments: Ava Martinez (2025-02-11): Please add a clear note in NOTES.txt about the INIT_CONFIGMAP name so operators can grep logs during debugging. Also suggest gating the new upgrade-job behind values.upgrade.enable (resolved in a follow-up commit to preserve opt-in).

Ravi Patel (2025-02-12): I hit a race when testing init-job in KIND where the webhook was created before init completed; can we add an ownerReference or finalizer to the webhook cleanup job? Response: added webhook-cleanup-job.yaml and finalizer logic in init-job template (commit f5d4b2e).

Lina Chen (2025-02-13): Can the schema validation CI step be non-blocking for draft PRs? Answer: it's on a non-blocking CI stage for feature branches but will be required for merge to main. CI updated accordingly.
QA (2025-02-14): Integration tests show one flaky case on slow clusters where init job backoff doesn't wait long enough; increased default backoff and retries (commit f5d4b2e).
SRE (2025-02-15): Approved after verifying rollback-path does not remove user-managed CRs.
release_notes: charts/private-installer: add formal values.schema.json to validate private deployments and prevent silent breakage during upgrades.
charts/private-installer: idempotent init hooks with completion ConfigMap to coordinate resources and improve upgrade stability.
charts/private-installer: upgrade-job with pre/post checks to detect unsafe upgrades and provide remediation guidance.
docs: update installer/upgrade docs with air-gap and rollback guidance.
notes_for_ops: Run `helm template -f values.yaml charts/private-installer --validate` in CI or locally to catch schema issues. Before upgrading production clusters run the pre-upgrade Job in dry-run mode (see docs/installer/upgrades.md) and ensure the INIT_CONFIGMAP is present after init jobs complete. For air-gapped installs, ensure values.network.egress is correctly set and CSI drivers are present if using storage.backend=csi.
